name: Victoria Gilroy
original_name: ヴィクトリア・ギローイ
source:
Race: Anima

The Chief Secretary of Jimill Republic. She is very paranoid and does not trust anyone at all. Strongly committed to maintaining her power, anyone who criticizes her are purged, even her own relatives.
